cards.front: Recall a key point about Question Forms and Modal Verbs
cards.back: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for question forms and modal verbs. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons.

cards.front: What should you know about gcse spanish exam tips?
cards.back: Spanish questions use inverted question marks (¿...?). Question words (qué, quién, cuándo, dónde, cómo, por qué, cuánto). Modal verbs: poder (can), deber (must/should), querer (want), saber (know how to). Use modal + infinitive structure.
